chapters.caption: Staged offline demo. Actual extension page; sample inputs; no live retailer or model call.
Choose two card products. Reported annual online-retail spend is $0 for this example.
Enter a $100 eligible Best Buy US purchase and explicitly confirm its exclusions.
The rules engine estimates $3.00 and $1.50. These are conditional estimates, not earned rewards.
The result includes source links, a terms expiry and eligibility limitations.
Unknown annual usage produces a $1.00–$3.00 range; the best card may change.
Lock hides private inputs and clears the session key. The local record stays encrypted.
Deletion requires explicit confirmation and can be done without the forgotten phrase.
Local data is cleared. This offline demo is not deployment, live LLM evaluation or store approval.
